sloka: ततो रथं समास्थाय रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।तत्सैन्यमतिसङ्क्रुद्धः प्रविवेश सुदारुणम् ।। ७.२९.२२ ॥
transliteration: tato rathaṁ samāsthāya rāvaṇiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।tatsainyamatisaṅkruddhaḥ praviveśa sudāruṇam ।। 7.29.22 ॥

translations.english: Then, Indrajit, consumed by extreme rage, mounted his chariot and furiously entered that formidable army.
